chunks: From him, from Bunan ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from al-Sakuni, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father (peace be upon him), who said:
"Whoever does not make a will at the time of his death for his relatives who do not inherit him, has concluded his deeds with disobedience."

key_terms.مِمَّنْ لَا يَرِثُهُ: from those who do not inherit him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on making a will for relatives who do not inherit?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* underscores the obligation (wujub) of drafting a will for non-heirs to prevent the dissipation of wealth and ensure their care, a practice deeply rooted in the Prophet's tradition. Scholars interpret 'ending with disobedience' as a spiritual warning that neglecting this final duty compromises one's overall piety and accountability on the Day of Judgment.
